items: Ranks corrected — removed PU rank throughout; cabin crew are IFD / FA only (T6 base × rank matrix no longer emits PU).
T3 Legality: rule 7501 retired and replaced by 7508 (F8 calendar-day Single Day Free from Duty, with a Duty-Report Y/N parameter).
T3 Legality: added rule 2015 — DO (Day-Off) Definition, a definition-type rule that feeds the downstream days-off rules (7505 / 7507), analogous to 2014 Local Night Definition.

T3 Legality: added rule 7509 — Avoid Co-pairing (crew not to fly together); restricted crew-ID pairs are entered INLINE in the rule (Crew A · Crew B · Eff Date · Exp Date), and the match spans different bases and divisions. Shipped 2026-08-23 to the F8 solver ruleset and the Rust legality engine.
T3 Legality grew from 21 to 23 cases; workbook totals updated accordingly.

Added T6 Solver Quality tab (44 cases) — validates a finished scenario's roster QUALITY: coverage, seniority respect, bid satisfaction, credit-hour balance, KPI, distribution, versions and algorithm parameters, plus a base × rank scenario matrix. Distinct from the Admin-UI Scenario cases, which cover creating/kicking-off a run.
Baseline for the change log — earlier revisions (V1–V3) predate this tracker.
